title: The Vector of Sector Nine
author: Yara Galloway
blurb: Paloma Thackeray, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
